'''2023 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Morristown, New Jersey, 11–13 August 2023. [[Hayes Hunter]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-07-world-championships-morristown-new-jersey-aug-11-13/</ref> Friday team event winners: [[Justin Desai]] and [[Jonny Chu]] (Kashyyyk Train of Dominance); runners-up [[Scott Lingrell]] and [[Bill Bacheler]].<ref name="wrap">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-world-championship-wrap-up-hayes-hunter-secures-his-first-crown/</ref>

* '''Site:''' Morristown, New Jersey
* '''Dates:''' 11–13 August 2023
